stem:
Farid fills a number pyramid. Each box is the sum of the two boxes directly below it. The top box is $20$ and the lower-left box touching it is $7$. The lower-right box touching the top is missing.

What value belongs in the missing box?

options.text: Write $20$ again in the missing box, treating the top label as the missing entry.
Add $20$ and $7$, without using only the two boxes that touch under the top box.
$13$, because the missing lower box is $20 - 7$.
Say the missing value is what creates the pyramid rule, instead of using the known adjacent sum.

teacher.key_rationale: When a top box and one touching lower box are known, the other touching lower box is the top minus the known lower box: 20 - 7 = 13.
